#!/bin/sh
# worldcradle-managed Don't Starve Together server — generated by provision().
# This server's own files: <ROOT>/home/.klei/DoNotStarveTogether/wc_test
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
python3 - "<ROOT>/home/.klei/DoNotStarveTogether/wc_test/cluster.ini" "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'SYNC'
import re, sys
p, join, admin = sys.argv[1:4]
t = open(p, encoding="utf-8", newline="").read()     # keep its line endings
bom = "\ufeff" if t.startswith("\ufeff") else ""
t = t[len(bom):]
for key, val in (
    ('cluster_password', join),
):
    line = key + ' = ' + val
    pattern = r'(?m)^' + re.escape(key + ' = ') + r'[^\r\n]*'
    if re.search(pattern, t):
        t = re.sub(pattern, lambda m: line, t)
    else:
        pass   # not in the file: left out
open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="").write(bom + t)
SYNC
(cd "<ROOT>/installs/dst/bin64" && exec env --default-signal=INT ./dontstarve_dedicated_server_nullrenderer_x64 -persistent_storage_root "<ROOT>/home/.klei" -conf_dir DoNotStarveTogether -cluster wc_test -shard Caves) &
cd "<ROOT>/installs/dst/bin64" || exit 1
exec ./dontstarve_dedicated_server_nullrenderer_x64 -persistent_storage_root "<ROOT>/home/.klei" -conf_dir DoNotStarveTogether -cluster wc_test -shard Master
